movedSlug:
*[_type == $type && !(_id in path("drafts.**")) && $slug in previousSlugs && defined(slug.current) && slug.current != $slug]
  | order(_updatedAt desc)[0]{"slug": slug.current, "isHome": _id == *[_id == "siteSettings"][0].homePage._ref}
eventsListPage:
*[_type == "contentPage" && !(_id in path("drafts.**")) && defined(slug.current) && count(modules[_type == "upcomingEvents"]) > 0]
  | order(_createdAt asc)[0]{"slug": slug.current, "isHome": _id == *[_id == "siteSettings"][0].homePage._ref, "sectionId": modules[_type == "upcomingEvents"][0].sectionId}
